answer: The popular fable that an unbound wallet can enter at full weight is replaced by a spiral of decaying vouchers: each established issuer may grant only a few per epoch, and each voucher binds a unique work sample the issuer re-ran, compactly committed as a pearl digest. Vote power stays locked until that path is unique and cools; a colliding sample voids every voucher on the path, so farms must buy scarce issuer attention rather than mint keys.
